creator: kdelacruz94
title: V52-Everforest-QWERTY
notes:
Sunaku's Keymap v52 for the "Glorious Engrammer" 🧑‍🚀🚀✨
- Intro & setup: https://github.com/sunaku/glove80-keymaps/tree/v52/#readme
- Release notes: https://github.com/sunaku/glove80-keymaps/releases/tag/v52
- Printable map: https://github.com/sunaku/glove80-keymaps/raw/v52/README/all-layer-diagrams.pdf
- Documentation: https://sunaku.github.io/moergo-glove80-keyboard.html#layers
- Discord forum: #glorious-engrammer channel in https://www.moergo.com/discord

--- Modifications (2026-06-12) ---
- QWERTY default base (Enthium/Dvorak/Colemak/macOS layers removed)
- Emoji layer repurposed as Excel layer
- World layer removed
- Magic-layer switching for Excel family (C6R6+C6R2..C3R2) and Gaming family (C6R6+C6R3..C3R3)
- Placeholder layers added: Excel_WordPP, Excel_Code, Excel_TBD, LoL, Gaming_TBD
  (kept but not selectable from Magic until they have bindings)
- Everforest Dark Hard RGB palette

decoration.description: Monitor input: switch to DisplayPort (work desktop). Win+Ctrl+Alt+F11, bound on each host to a ControlMyMonitor script setting VCP 0x60 to the DisplayPort value.
Monitor input: switch to USB-C (work laptop). Win+Ctrl+Alt+F12, bound on each host to a ControlMyMonitor script setting VCP 0x60 to the USB-C value.
Screenshot: Win+Shift+S (Windows Snipping Tool). On CachyOS/Hyprland the same chord must be bound to a grim/slurp or hyprshot command.
Previous workspace (Win+Ctrl+Left); pairs with Right C6R1 next workspace.
herdr prefix: Ctrl+B. Tap, then the action key.
Push-to-talk dictation (F13): hold to record, release to transcribe.
